summary: A switch for an on/off setting, with its label, description and error laid out beside it, taking part in forms.

label.note: Visible label next to the switch and accessible name. Required: shadow DOM keeps an external <label for> from naming the inner input.

hideLabel.note: Visually hides the label; it stays the accessible name. Use only when other visible text next to the switch names it.

description.note: Help text under the label, in the accessible description.

error.note: Error message. Setting it marks the field invalid and sets a customError validity (SB-0009).

value.note: Submitted with the form while on; nothing is submitted while off.

checked.note: On or off. Not reflected: the attribute is the default restored by form reset.

required.note: Native required: the switch must be on (valueMissing while off). Adds an aria-hidden asterisk after the label.

disabled.note: Native disabled; dimmed; not focusable; not submitted. A disabled fieldset ancestor has the same effect without touching this attribute.

size.note: Track and thumb size: default 32x20 track with a 16px thumb, sm 24x16 track with a 12px thumb. The label text does not change.

anatomy.name: field
anatomy.notes: Grid: the switch in the first column; label, description and error in the second.

anatomy.name: control
anatomy.notes: The track: a pill holding the native input and the thumb.

anatomy.name: input
anatomy.notes: Native <input type="checkbox" role="switch"> covering the track; receives focus, Space and validation.

anatomy.name: thumb
anatomy.notes: The round knob; at the start while off, at the end while on (mirrored in RTL). aria-hidden.

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.notes: Native <label for> in the same shadow root; clicking it toggles.

anatomy.name: error
anatomy.notes: Persistent polite live region; text appears when invalid.

input.note: Each toggle. Native and composed, so it crosses the shadow boundary.

change.note: Toggle committed. Re-dispatched from the host because native change is not composed (NativeControl). FormData read in a listener already has the new value.

focus-visible.note: 3px solid ring around the track (a translucent ring would fall under 3:1).

checked.note: Track fills with primary and the thumb slides to the end.

invalid.trigger: error set, or required and off after blur or a submit attempt

disabled.trigger: disabled attribute or a disabled fieldset ancestor

accessibility.accessibleNameSource: The label prop, through a native <label for> in the same shadow root.

formAssociation.note: FormAssociated + NativeControl mixins. ElementInternals: setFormValue(value) only while on, null while off; validity mirrored from the inner input (required -> valueMissing while off); formResetCallback restores the default from the checked attribute; formStateRestoreCallback restores checked; a disabled fieldset disables it through isDisabled and it is not submitted; <label for> on the host is forwarded to the inner input; syncFormState runs in the change handler.

accessibility.targetSize: Track is 32x20 (sm 24x16); the label is part of the clickable row and the 12px gap satisfies the WCAG 2.5.8 spacing exception.
accessibility.focusRingVisible: On keyboard focus of the input; 3px ring in switch.focus-ring.color around the track.
accessibility.missingNameWarning: Dev-only console warning, once, when label is empty.

keyboard.Tab: move focus to and from the switch
keyboard.Enter: submits the form (implicit submission; the control has no form owner in its shadow root, SB-0009); it does not toggle

aria: role="switch" on the native checkbox: aria-checked true/false comes from the native checked state
aria-describedby -> description and error ids (same root)
required: native required; the asterisk is aria-hidden
error: sets a customError validity, so the form blocks submission
thumb is aria-hidden; state is never conveyed by color or position alone, the role announces on/off
no mixed state: role switch has no aria-checked="mixed"
announcements: on/off is announced by the screen reader on toggle (native role switch)
error text is announced once when it appears (persistent aria-live=polite region)

useCases.when: A setting that is on or off, such as notifications or airplane mode
useCases.use: sb-switch with a label that names the setting

useCases.when: The effect of turning it on needs explaining
A compact settings list or table row
The form cannot be sent unless the setting is on

antiPatterns.pattern: A switch for choosing items from a list, or for agreeing to terms
antiPatterns.why: A switch turns a setting on or off; selecting options and giving consent are checkbox choices (APG switch pattern)

antiPatterns.pattern: A switch whose label changes with its state ("On" / "Off")
antiPatterns.why: The role already announces on and off; a label that flips makes the name and the state disagree (APG switch pattern)
antiPatterns.alternative: A fixed label that names the setting

antiPatterns.pattern: A switch that toggles a pressed look on a toolbar button
antiPatterns.why: A pressed button is a different role with a different look

drift.contract: label, description and error are props of Switch
drift.realization: shadcn composes Field and Label parts around Switch; shadow DOM requires them inside (as Checkbox, SB-0005)
shadcn uses bg-input, neutral-200 in light mode, below 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11)

drift.contract: background while off, primary-foreground while on, in every mode
drift.realization: shadcn dark uses foreground while off and primary-foreground while on; one alias per token keeps the thumb above 3:1 against the track in both modes
shadcn uses 1.15rem (18.4px) and 14px for sm; rounded to the size scale
not reflected: the attribute is the default restored by form reset

openQuestions.question: Contract content drafted with the contract-author skill (visual reference, WAI-ARIA APG)?
openQuestions.answer: Yes: the visual reference for look, sizes and API; APG switch pattern for role and keyboard; Checkbox's field layout for label, description and error.

openQuestions.question: Which native element carries the role: <input type=checkbox role=switch> or <button role=switch aria-checked>?
openQuestions.recommendation: The native checkbox with role=switch (SB-0007): it brings Space, checked, required/valueMissing and label activation for free; a button would re-implement all of them.
openQuestions.answer: Native <input type="checkbox" role="switch">, extending FormAssociated + NativeControl like Checkbox. Recommendation taken; no approver was available.

openQuestions.question: Does Enter toggle the switch (APG lists it as optional) or submit the form?
openQuestions.recommendation: Submit the form, like Checkbox and the native checkbox (SB-0009). Space is the toggle key.
openQuestions.answer: Enter submits through form.requestSubmit() and does not toggle. Recommendation taken; no approver was available.

openQuestions.question: Is checked reflected to an attribute?
openQuestions.recommendation: No: the attribute is the default restored by form reset (native defaultChecked), as Checkbox.
openQuestions.answer: No. Recommendation taken; no approver was available.

openQuestions.question: Is label required, and how is a switch without visible text named?
openQuestions.recommendation: Required, like Checkbox and Input; hide-label keeps it as the accessible name.
openQuestions.answer: label is required; hide-label hides it visually; an empty label logs a dev-only warning. Recommendation taken; no approver was available.

openQuestions.question: Which sizes, and what do they change?
openQuestions.recommendation: The two sizes of the visual reference, default and sm (API alias medium and small). They change track and thumb only; the label and description keep their type so a row lines up with the rest of the form.
openQuestions.answer: size="default" (32x20 track, 16px thumb) and size="sm" (24x16 track, 12px thumb) from the existing size.switch.* and size.icon.* semantic tokens. Recommendation taken; no approver was available.

openQuestions.question: What does required mean for a switch?
openQuestions.recommendation: Native semantics: the switch must be on (valueMissing while off), shown invalid after blur or a submit attempt, with the aria-hidden asterisk. Usage guidance points consent to Checkbox.
openQuestions.answer: Must be on; native valueMissing message; invalid shown after blur or a submit attempt. Recommendation taken; no approver was available.

openQuestions.question: Does the switch support an indeterminate (mixed) state or readonly?
openQuestions.recommendation: No. Role switch has no mixed state in ARIA, and a native checkbox ignores readonly; neither was asked for.
openQuestions.answer: Neither is supported. Recommendation taken; no approver was available.

openQuestions.question: Can the label sit before the switch (settings-list layout)?
openQuestions.recommendation: Not in this version: the label follows the switch, as Checkbox. A justified settings row is composed with Item or Field when needed.
openQuestions.answer: Label after the switch only. Recommendation taken; no approver was available.

openQuestions.question: How does the switch look in forced-colors mode and with reduced motion?
openQuestions.recommendation: Forced colors: the track border becomes visible (CanvasText) and the on thumb and track use Highlight, so on and off stay distinct. prefers-reduced-motion: the thumb moves without a transition.
openQuestions.answer: Both as recommended; the system colors are literals with a sketchbook-allow-literal reason in the SCSS. Recommendation taken; no approver was available.
